# Lumastra Contributor License Agreement (Individual)

_Version 1.2 — October 2026._ The revision of this file that is current in the Project's public
repository when you submit a Contribution governs that Contribution. A later revision applies
only to Contributions you submit after it is published.

Thank you for contributing to Lumastra. This Contributor License Agreement (the "Agreement")
records the rights you grant when you contribute. It is adapted from the widely-used Apache
Software Foundation Individual CLA, with an added clause (§3) that preserves Lumastra's
open-core dual-licensing model.

Each time you submit a Contribution (for example, by opening a pull request) you accept these
terms for that Contribution. They also apply to any Contribution you submitted before you first
accepted this Agreement. Where a CLA-signing bot is configured on the repository, recording your
agreement through it has the same effect as signing.

**Definitions.**

- **"You" / "Your"** means the individual who submits a Contribution.
- **"Project Owner"** means Denis Arnst (Sapd), the principal copyright holder and licensor of
  Lumastra, or a successor individual or entity to which ownership of the Project is
  transferred.
- **"Project"** means Lumastra, including its software, documentation, website content and
  related material, in every repository in which the Project Owner has enabled this Agreement
  (currently github.com/Sapd/lumastra and github.com/Sapd/lumastra-docs). One agreement covers
  all of them.
- **"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including any modifications or
  additions to existing work, that you intentionally submit to the Project, in any form:
  source code, documentation text, images, diagrams, translations or other material.

## 5. Originality

You represent that each of your Contributions is your original creation, except for material

Material produced with the help of AI or other tools under your direction is treated as your

If a Contribution includes material that is not your original creation (third-party code, text,

both under the open-source licenses and under the proprietary and commercial licenses described

If a Contribution includes work by another person (for example a co-author), you represent that
each of them has accepted this Agreement or has authorized you to submit their work under it.

## 11. Personal data (GDPR notice)

When you accept this Agreement through the signing bot, the following data is stored in a
private repository controlled by the Project Owner: your GitHub username and numeric user id,
the numeric id of the repository and the number of the pull request in which you agreed, the id
of the comment in which you agreed, and a timestamp. The record is shared by every Project
repository that uses the bot, so you sign once. No name, e-mail address or other data is
collected for this purpose.

- **Controller:** Denis Arnst, Austria — <git@sapd.eu>.
- **Purpose and legal basis:** evidencing the licenses you grant under this Agreement
  (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — performance of this Agreement — and Art. 6(1)(f), the legitimate
  interest in proving the project's right to distribute your Contribution).
- **Storage and recipients:** the record is a file in a private GitHub repository, hosted by
  GitHub, Inc. (USA, certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework). The commit that records
  your signature also names your GitHub username and the pull request.
- **Retention:** for as long as your Contribution is distributed by the project, plus the
  applicable limitation periods; the record is what proves the grant, so it cannot be erased
  while the Contribution remains in use (Art. 17(3)(e) GDPR).
- **Your rights:** access, rectification and the other rights under Chapter III GDPR, exercised
  by e-mail to the address above; erasure is limited by the purpose stated. You may complain to
  the Austrian data protection authority (Datenschutzbehörde).

GitHub itself processes the comment and pull request under its own terms.

## 12. Miscellaneous

If a provision of this Agreement is held invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions
stay in effect, and the invalid provision is replaced by a valid one that comes closest to its
purpose. This English version is the only binding version; translations are for convenience.

repository, code and documentation; §1 states how recipients are licensed, including the

AI-assisted work, third-party material and co-authors; §9 adds consent to modification and to
